TESTING · SECTION 3

“Try again” must return to a usable viewfinder.

Behavioural regression view · CU-A photo retry · #581
GIVEN

Photo capture fails

WHEN

User taps “Try again”

THEN

Viewfinder returns;
a fresh capture succeeds

Before fix FAIL→At f6cd896 PASS

Fault. Retry called capture from a state where its access guard immediately returned.

Repair. Return to the viewfinder so the user can make a fresh capture.

Check. Audit replayed the old source: the new test failed before the fix and passed afterward.
